## Description

A kidney-shaped ciliate (45–60 × 20–25 µm) that eats bacteria. It abounds in leaf infusions and is
the bacterivore of classic microcosms (Lawler and Morin 1993; Holyoak and Lawler 1996) and the prey of
*Didinium*. It conjugates.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 8 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A filter feeder with helical swimming; no measured speed, so it uses that of *Tetrahymena*, of
similar size. Contractile vacuole period estimated.

- Laybourn J.E.M. (1973) *The energetics of Colpidium campylum Stokes*. PhD thesis, University of

  J.M. (1974) J. Zool. 174: 277–283, doi:10.1111/j.1469-7998.1974.tb03157.x.
